Iris helps make homes safer, more energy efficient and easier to manage. Iris not only detects water leaks, but it also gives consumers the ability to shut off the water supply with water shut-off valves controlled by the Iris Hub application on a smartphone, tablet or computer. And Iris improves managing energy consumption by linking smart meters and adding energy-saving devices.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
